notes.title: Pits of Lushwood - Update 0.7.0.7
notes.notes: [p]Demo Hotfix update 0.7.0.7 is now live![/p][p][/p][p]The demo has been hotfixed of bugs, and a new terrain piece has been added; Pits.[/p][p]Push ground enemies into them to eliminate them, but be careful not to fall in yourself![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332640/efb4cf00ba07ec8f6e42e84ec6d55524c4a3c7ba.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo Hotfix 0.5.0.1
notes.notes:
Just updated the demo with a quick little hotfix adressing:

[list]
[*] Adding option for fullscreen windowed mode
[*] Letting the game run in background while loading. This should help players opening the game and browsing Steam while they wait for loading.
[*] Added tooltip for how to cleanse corrupted runes.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Demo 0.4.0.2
notes.notes:
I've just updated the demo with a small patch addressing some small issues I found when players were playing:

[list]
[*] Added proper control icons/names where appropriate when playing with controllers.
[*] Enhanced the auto aim slightly, to auto update when getting too far away from a target.
[*] Made an option for dropping runes with Y when playing with controllers.
[*] Made an option to auto-equip runes with X when playing with controllers.
[*] Adjusted the difficulty a little bit down on the first difficulty.
[*] Added appropriate error messages when players try to do actions they can't
[/list]

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix #2 now live
notes.notes:
The playtest is still going strong - thanks for everyone that plays and especially for the nice feedback you guys give! I really appreciate it! :)

The patch includes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where some particle systems wouldn't render correctly
[*] Added 4 new levels to make more diverse runs
[*] Fixed bug where Steam Deck users would run into some big lacks rendering them unable to play the game.
[*] Added "quit to camp" and "quite to main menu"
[*] Fixed issue with gamepad/keyboard navigation in menus.
[/list]

Happy gaming
- Mathias Zillo
Zillo Games

notes.title: Playtest Hotfix #1 now live!
notes.notes:
The playtest is going great and the feedback is rolling in - thanks for that, I really appreciate it! :) 

Based on the feedback I got, this is the first hotfix of the Alpha Playtest.
The patch includes:

[list]
[*] Fixed issue where the ice enemies would end in an endless immortal charge state
[*] Fixed a crash bug for Steam Deck users - Steam deck should be supported now.
[*] Made small adjustments of texts and icons where they were a bit unaligned
[*] Added option to navigate up and down dialogue options with W and S
[*] Added option to pick a dialogue option based on numbers (1,2,3 etc)
[*] Added the option to instant-write dialogue text when left clicking on the panel (before you had to click outside the panel)
[*] Added tooltips to the HUD elements (coins, diamonds, health bar etc)
[*] Added an option to open the feedback/bug tool in the in-game menu
[/list]

Happy gaming
- Mathias Zillo
Zillo Games
